'''Sleash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] thug who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This dar'kel spice should do the trick. Go gift it to Sleash before you ask him about Untas, and he should tell you anything you want. He has a weakness for this particular spice.|[[Oldksam]], to a bounty hunter|<ref name="SWG:FJ" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Sleash was known as a drug addict and resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. He was friend with the thug [[Untas]] and was acquainted with [[Oldksam]] and [[Taibela]]. Sleash also used to do business with [[Vaigon Shinn]], the leader of the [[Shinn muggers]].<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Untas was indebted to the crime boss [[Faeto]]. When Faeto placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on him, Oldksam, Sleash and Untas went into hiding. Sleash hided in [[Vaigon Shinn's Hideout]]. Nevertheless, Taibela stayed in Mos Eisley where she was questioned by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. The bounty hunter persuaded her to reveal where Oldksam was hiding and, after finding him, persuaded Oldksam to reveal Sleash's location. The bounty hunter finally arrived at Vaigon Shinn's Hideout and questioned Sleash. The bounty hunter gave Sleash his favorite [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and convinced him to talk. Sleash was upset that Untas went into hiding without him and gave his former partner's location, the [[White Thranta Shipping offices]]. The bounty hunter later found Untas, and finally killed him.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sleash was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sleash was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
